measurements.anchor_compute_sec_note: training work / published throughput of 'A100 80GB SXM4': 2 epochs x 100 iterations x batch 1280 = 256 000 images; / 1 582 images/s. The benchmark's throughput covers the training steps: start-up, data download and validation are outside it
